case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Estimate Exceeds Hard Credit Budget
tests: Checks that an over-budget estimate produces a clear budget warning and no generation, rather than an unauthorized cheaper substitute.

got.question:
I didn't make the clip and no credits were spent, because the cost is over your 30-credit limit.

**Why it's over:** The estimate you saw was 90 credits. Video on your free plan costs about 18–24 credits per second at 480p, so a 5-second clip lands somewhere around 90–120 credits, well above 30.

**Options that would fit under 30 credits:**
- **A 1-second clip** of the same scene, at about 24 cred

must_haves.item: The response states that the 90-credit estimate exceeds the 30-credit budget.
must_haves.why: The agent said the estimate was 90 credits and that the cost is over the user's 30-credit limit.

must_haves.item: The response clearly says generation has not started.
must_haves.why: The agent said it didn't make the clip and no credits were spent, and later confirmed again that nothing was made.

must_haves.item: No clip or substitute asset is delivered.
must_haves.why: The agent only offered cheaper options and asked first. It made nothing, the plan is empty, and it stopped when the user declined.

reply.summary: The agent met all three must-haves: it named the 90-credit estimate against the 30-credit limit, said clearly that nothing was generated, and delivered no clip or substitute.
